body:
## **Copy It**

A lightweight Fabric and Forge client-side mod that lets you copy your current Minecraft coordinates to your clipboard with a single keybind.

Perfect for sharing locations with friends, saving build spots, or quickly pasting coordinates into chat, notes, or Discord.

Features

📋 One-key coordinate copying

⌨️ Fully configurable keybind

🧭 Works in all dimensions

⚡ Client-side & server-safe

🧩 Supports Minecraft 1.20.1

# Requirements

**Fabric version: Fabric API**

**Forge version: No additional dependencies**
